t: 尼一仁是日本佛教僧人,他首次提出"纳木·妙花·伦格·觉"并宣布这是佛教的精髓,实际上创立了尼一…
te: Nichiren, a Japanese Buddhist monk, propounds Namu Myōhō Renge Kyō for the first time and declares it to be the essence…
dz: 尼一仁是日本佛教僧人,他首次提出"纳木·妙花·伦格·觉"并宣布这是佛教的精髓,实际上创立了尼一仁佛教.
de: Nichiren, a Japanese Buddhist monk, propounds Namu Myōhō Renge Kyō for the first time and declares it to be the essence of Buddhism, in effect founding Nichiren Buddhism.

t: 阿维斯内斯的约翰一世击败了丹皮耶尔的盖伊.
te: John I of Avesnes defeats Guy of Dampierre.
dz: 西卡佩尔战役:阿维斯内斯的约翰一世击败了丹皮耶尔的盖伊.
de: Battle of West-Capelle: John I of Avesnes defeats Guy of Dampierre.

t: 明道加斯被加冕为立陶宛国王.
te: Mindaugas is crowned King of Lithuania.
dz: 明道加斯被加冕为立陶宛国王.
de: Mindaugas is crowned King of Lithuania.

t: 教皇英诺森四世封圣了被国王博列斯瓦夫二世杀害的什切帕努夫的斯坦尼斯劳斯。
te: Pope Innocent IV canonises Stanislaus of Szczepanów, who was killed by King Bolesław II.
dz: 教皇英诺森四世封圣了被国王博列斯瓦夫二世杀害的什切帕努夫的斯坦尼斯劳斯。
de: Pope Innocent IV canonises Stanislaus of Szczepanów, who was killed by King Bolesław II.
